test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses the indefinite article.

options.text: He has a keen eye for business and every year his firm makes a great profit.
He has a keen eye for business and every year his firm makes great a profit.
He has keen eye for business and every year his firm makes great profit.
He has a keen eye for business and every year his firm makes great profit.

solution:
The correct answer is** "He has a keen eye for business and every year his firm makes a great profit".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The indefinite article (a, an) is **used before a noun that is general or when its identity is not known.**
 
• **Here in the answer**** interest ( keen eye ****) and profit cannot be defined specifically and hence indefinite articles are used before them.**
 
• **'An' is used before words starting with the vowels.**

**Therefore, the correct answer is**** -**** ***He has a keen eye for business and every year his firm makes a great profit***.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**
